invariants: Every migration table must appear exactly once in this map.
Every module manifest database table must exist in the migration set and this map.
Every ledger or append-only table must declare protection and a test binding.
Projection and read-side tables are never business fact write owners.
Finance ledger tables can only be written by Money/Ledger Kernel or append-only correction policy.

Every current executable action must bind Definition, Command, Unit of Work, table groups, DomainEvent or explicit no-event reason, LedgerEntry policy, read-only Search / Projection / Lens, and tests.
